pages.title: Example — tools for small teams
pages.text: Example is a scheduling tool for small teams. Start a free trial in two minutes. Pricing starts at 9 EUR per month.

pages.title: Documentation — getting started
pages.text: Create an account, connect a calendar, and invite your team. The API uses a bearer token. Rate limit is 60 requests per minute.

pages.title: Frequently asked questions
pages.description: Common questions about billing and data.
pages.text: You can cancel at any time. Data is stored in the EU. Refunds are available within 14 days.
